integrity: The proof uses only the published torus basis and Theorem 5.6 basis-level Frobenius formula. No finite experiment or unverified computational certificate is used. The source premises were inspected directly in the full manuscript.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to the torus PGL2 skein Frobenius homomorphism when the source order \(n=\operatorname{ord}(q^2)\) is even. It identifies the linear kernel only; it does not classify the image, quotient algebra, or other surfaces.
title: Exact one-dimensional kernel of the even-order PGL2 torus Frobenius map
